saveRule: There is NO mission replay and NO New Game Plus at launch. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. If a story choice or a miss goes wrong, the save is the only way back.

stages.goal: Finish Chapters 1-4 and the final mission. Earn the 13 story trophies.
notes: SAVE at the start of every chapter, and again before the final mission.
DO THE MISSABLE FIRST: during Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house (Positive Mental Attitude). It is gone after Chapter 1 — the game's only missable trophy.
From Chapter 2, scan vehicles and study animals with binoculars as you travel — 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals count toward 100%.
Make story choices whenever offered — Actions Speak Louder tracks a count toward 500.
stages.title: Story first — and save smart

stages.goal: Finish every side-story finale and 8 stranger strands.
notes: Side-story finales stay open after the credits: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, and Bret's hunt.
Stranger missions appear as icons while you explore — finish 8 full strands.
Hunt Bret's unique animal and scan animals with binoculars first.
stages.title: Side stories and strangers

stages.goal: Clear the activity trophies: range, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, stunts, challenges.
notes: Try all 9 activity types once for Master of None — one attempt each is enough.
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges for The Shootist.
Win drone races at all 14 locations and 20 different races.
Meditate at the remaining 17 spots (the Chapter 1 spot is done in Stage 1).
Complete 250 stunts now; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going.
stages.title: Activities and skills

stages.goal: Robberies, vehicles, cards, WAiNK, garages, shops — the open-world bulk.
notes: Rob 5 bank vaults and an armored truck; launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts.
Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Discover 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas, WAiNK It at 100 locations — one road trip feeds all three.
Buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
With your partner: lose a 4-star wanted level (Hot Together) and rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing the heat (Retail Therapy).
stages.title: Crime, collectibles and the world

stages.goal: Attain 100% completion, then collect the platinum.
notes: Open the in-game 100% checklist and work from it — it does not require everything, only what it counts.
70 of 80 challenges. 300 stunts. 200 of 277 vehicles scanned. 100 of 255 animals studied.
When A Long Road pops, Vice Got a Price! follows at once — the platinum is yours.
stages.title: 100% cleanup — A Long Road, then Platinum

title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
